words: taxi
/ˈtæksi/ noun. 出租车（指供出租的载客汽车）
regret

exciting
/ɪkˈsaɪtɪŋ/ adjective. 令人兴奋的（描述令人激动的事物）
thief
/θiːf/ noun. 小偷，贼（复数形式为thieves）
rush
/rʌʃ/ verb. 冲，奔（表示快速地移动）
fright
/fraɪt/ noun. 害怕，恐惧（常用于get a fright短语中）
battered

phrases: used to do sth
表示过去习惯性的动作或状态，现在已不再发生
Roy used to drive a taxi.
Roy过去常开出租车。
a short while ago
表示不久之前，相当于not long ago
A short while ago, he became a bus driver.
不久之前，他成了一名公交车司机。
far more exciting
far用于加强比较级，表示更加、得多
He is finding his new work far more exciting.
他发现新工作更加令人兴奋。
rush out of
从...冲出来
He saw two thieves rush out of a shop.
他看见两个小偷从一家商店冲出来。
run towards
朝...跑去
The thieves ran towards a waiting car.
小偷们朝一辆等候的汽车跑去。
act quickly
迅速行动
Roy acted quickly and drove the bus straight at the thieves.
Roy迅速行动，把公交车直接开向小偷。
such...that...
如此...以至于...
The one with the money got such a fright that he dropped the bag.
拿着钱的小偷吓得把袋子都掉了。
get away
逃走，离开
As the thieves were trying to get away in their car...
当小偷们试图开车逃走时...
shortly afterwards
不久之后
Shortly afterwards, the police stopped the car.
不久之后，警察拦住了那辆车。

grammar.f: 主语 + used to + 动词原形
grammar.d: 表示过去经常发生的动作或存在的状态，而现在已不再发生 用于描述过去的习惯或状态，与现在形成对比
ex: Roy used to drive a taxi.
He used to smoke, but now he doesn't.
他以前抽烟，但现在不抽了。

grammar.f: such + a/an + 形容词 + 可数名词单数 + that...
grammar.d: such后面接名词，that引导结果状语从句，表示如此...以至于... 强调程度之高导致某种结果
ex: He got such a fright that he dropped the bag.
It was such a hot day that we went swimming.
天气太热了，我们去游泳了。

grammar.f: While + 主语 + was/were + 动词-ing, 主语 + 动词过去式
grammar.d: while引导的时间状语从句，表示两个动作同时进行 用于描述两个正在进行的动作同时发生
ex: While the battered car was moving away, Roy stopped his bus.
当那辆破车开走时，Roy停下了公交车。
While I was reading, she was cooking.
我看书的时候，她在做饭。

patterns.p: 主语 + used to + 动词原形
o: Roy Trenton used to drive a taxi.
im: I used to live in Shanghai.
She used to play the piano.

patterns.p: 主语 + saw + 宾语 + 动词原形
o: He saw two thieves rush out of a shop.
他看见两个小偷从一家商店冲出来。
im: I saw him leave the room.
She saw the bird fly away.

patterns.p: such + a/an + 形容词 + 名词 + that...
o: The one with the money got such a fright that he dropped the bag.
拿着钱的小偷吓得把袋子都掉了。
im: He made such a mistake that everyone laughed.
他犯了如此可笑的错误，大家都笑了。
It was such a beautiful day that we went to the park.
天气太好了，我们去了公园。

o: Roy acted quickly and drove the bus straight at the thieves.
Roy迅速行动，把公交车直接开向小偷。
im: The fireman acted quickly and saved the child.
消防员迅速行动，救了那个孩子。
She acted quickly when she saw the accident.
看到事故时她迅速采取了行动。
